input.summary: Add a Company-only convenience termination right on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees
input.comment: [Playbook] Today we may only walk away for convenience when no Statement of Work is outstanding, which locks us in for the life of every engagement. We have added a Company-only right to terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees; Contractor's convenience right remains limited to periods with no outstanding Statement of Work.

ops.text: In addition, Company may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience upon thirty (30) days advance written notice to Contractor, in which case Contractor shall refund any prepaid fees on a pro rata basis for the period after the effective date of such termination.
